en.sayed-ali-raza: Beware! I called you (insistingly) to fight these people night and day, secretly and openly
and exhorted you to attack them before they attacked you, because by Allāh, no people have been attacked in the hearts of their houses but they suffered disgrace;
but you put it off to others and forsook it till destruction befell you and your cities were occupied.
The horsemen of Banu Ghamid [1] have reached al-Anbār and killed Ḥassān ibn Ḥassān al-Bakri. They have removed your horsemen from the garrison.
